implementation: Scoped Metal command buffers register addCompletedHandler before commit using block2 0.6.2. Handler holds Weak service and signals only. Shared scope worker uses nonblocking completion collection and generation-counted Condvar waits; cancellation and metadata publication also signal. No backend wait_idle in async scope service
dependency: Target-specific block2=0.6.2 for macOS/iOS; existing public explicit wait APIs unchanged
limits: Completion waits have16ms timeout fallback for missed/unavailable signals; no latency/throughput/energy claim
No physical device hang/removal/OOM test; fully-idle device-removal notifications remain open
Cancellation retires scope waiters, not GPU execution; pending resources still require normal completion collection/drop
Earlier benchmark results describe older implementations and do not qualify this signal-driven path
